stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

def solve(g):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pos=[(r,k) for r,row in enumerate(g) for k,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]

    while stack:
        r,c=stack.pop()
        for dr in(-1,0,1):
            for dc in(-1,0,1):
                n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if n in pos and n not in seen:
                    seen.add(n); stack.append(n); comp.append(n)
    posset={p for p in pos}
    mark=[p for p in pos if p not in set(comp)]
    mr,mc=mark[0]
    S={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in comp}

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pos=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    cc=Counter(g[r][c] for r,c in pos)
    shcol=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    scell=[(r,c) for r,c in pos if g[r][c]==shcol]
    (mr,mc),=[(r,c) for r,c in pos if g[r][c]!=shcol]
    tl=(min(r for r,c in scell), min(c for r,c in scell))
    R=max(r for r,c in scell)-tl[0]+1; C=max(c for r,c in scell)-tl[1]+1
    cr=sum(r for r,c in scell)/len(scell); ccl=sum(c for r,c in scell)/len(scell)
    sr=1 if mr>cr else -1; scc=1 if mc>ccl else -1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    k=1
    while True:
        drawn=False
        for r,c in scell:
            nr,nc=tl[0]+k*sr*R+r-tl[0], tl[1]+k*scc*C+c-tl[1]
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w:

        k+=1

def solve(g):

                stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen or g[y][x]!=g[r][c]: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and g[ny][nx]==g[r][c] and (ny,nx) not in seen: stack.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append(cells)
    shape=max(comps,key=len)
    scell=set(shape)
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if (r,c) not in scell and g[r][c]!=bg]
    rs=[p[0] for p in shape]; cs=[p[1] for p in shape]

    H=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; W=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
    def disjoint(tr,tc):

    step=None
    for s in range(1,40):
        tr=min(rs)+sr*s; tc=min(cs)+sd*(-s)
        if disjoint(tr,tc):

                col=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen or g[y][x]!=col: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and g[ny][nx]==col and (ny,nx) not in seen:

                comps.append(cells)

    scell=set(big)
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in scell]
    rs=[p[0] for p in big]; cs=[p[1] for p in big]
    cr=(min(rs)+max(rs))/2; cc=(min(cs)+max(cs))/2
    sr=int(marks[0][0]>cr)-int(marks[0][0]<cr)
    sd=int(marks[0][1]>cc)-int(marks[0][1]<cc)
    def disjoint(tr,tc):
        return not any((tr+a,tc+b) in scell for a,b in big)
    best=None
    for a,b in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]:
        for s in range(1,60):
            tr=min(rs)+a*s; tc=min(cs)+b*s
            if disjoint(tr,tc):
                adj=any(abs(tr+A-rs_)==1 and abs(tc+B-cs_)==1 for A,B in big for rs_,cs_ in big)
                if adj:
                    best=(a,b,s,tr,tc); break
        if best: break
    a,b,s=best[:3]
    dr_,dc_=a,b
    tr=min(rs)+dr_*s; tc=min(cs)+dc_*s
    while True:

    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells,mc=comps_of(g)  # comp list of (col,cells); background is first entry? no: comps_of returns bg+list incl markers as separate comps
    big=max(cells,key=lambda c:len(c[1]))  # largest col-cell comp = shape; color big[0]

def comps_of(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; out=[]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if not seen[y][x]:
                st=[(y,x)]; seen[y][x]=True; cs=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cs.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny][nx]:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(cs)
    return out

def solve(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=comps_of(g); bgc=g[cs[0][0][0]][cs[0][0][1]]
    big=max(cs,key=len)
    shape=tuple(sorted(big)); scell=set(shape)
    marks=[p for c in cs if c is not big for p in c]
    marks=[p for p in marks if g[p[0]][p[1]]!=bgc]
    draw=g[marks[0][0]][marks[0][1]]
    rs=[p[0] for p in shape]; csx=[p[1] for p in shape]
    a0,b0=min(rs),min(csx)
    mr=sum(p[0] for p in marks)/len(marks); mc_=sum(p[1] for p in marks)/len(marks)
    sy=1 if mr>(min(rs)+max(rs))/2 else -1
    sx=1 if mc_>(min(csx)+max(csx))/2 else -1
    outg=[r[:] for r in g]
    k=1
    while True:
        tr,tc=a0+sy*k,b0+sx*k
        if any((A+tr,B+tc) in scell for A,B in shape): break
        # count markers hit
        nhit=sum(((A+tr,B+tc)==(py,px)) for py,px in marks)
        if nhit==0: break
        break
    pos=(a0+sy*k,b0+sx*k)
    while True:
        n=0
        for A,B in shape:
            y,x=A+pos[0],B+pos[1]
            if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and outg[y][x]==bgc: outg[y][x]=draw;n+=1
        if n==0: break
        pos=(pos[0]+sy,pos[1]+sx)
        if not any(0<=A+pos[0]<h and 0<=B+pos[1]<w for A,B in shape): break
    return outg

def solve(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells={(y,x) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if g[y][x]!=bgc}
    cs=comps_of(cells); shape=max(cs,key=len)
    scell=set(shape)
    # markers: non-bg cells not in shape comp
    marks=[p for p in cells if p not in scell]
    my=sum(p[0] for p in shape)/len(shape); mx=sum(p[1] for p in shape)/len(shape)
    mr=sum(p[0] for p in marks)/len(marks); mcl=sum(p[1] for p in marks)/len(marks)
    dy=1 if mr>my else -1
    dx=1 if mcl>mx else -1
    outg=[r[:] for r in g]
    # first copy placed adjacent to shape in that diagonal direction (one shape-size gap?) 
    # use min extent + step so first copy touches shape border diagonally? try: translate shape by (dy,dx) then keep stepping
    pos=(min(p[0] for p in shape)+dy,min(p[1] for p in shape)+dx)

        n=0

            if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and outg[y][x]==bgc: outg[y][x]=g[shape[0][0]][shape[0][1]];n+=1
        if n==0: break
        if not any(0<=A+pos[0]+dy<h and 0<=B+pos[1]+dx<w for A,B in shape): break
        pos=(pos[0]+dy,pos[1]+dx)

def solve(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    shape=[(y,x) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if g[y][x]!=bgc]
    scell=set(shape)
    cc=Counter(v for v in [g[y][x] for y,x in shape])
    shcol=max(cc,key=lambda k:cc[k]); draw=None
    for v,c_ in cc.items():
        if v!=shcol: draw=v
    marks=[p for p in scell if g[p[0]][p[1]]!=shcol]
    my=sum(p[0] for p in shape)/len(shape); mx=sum(p[1] for p in shape)/len(shape)
    mr=sum(p[0] for p in marks)/len(marks); mcl=sum(p[1] for p in marks)/len(marks)
    dy=1 if mr>my else -1
    dx=1 if mcl>mx else -1
    outg=[r[:] for r in g]
    k=1
    while True:
        D=(k*dy,k*dx)
        inv=[(A+D[0],B+D[1]) for A,B in shape]
        inv=[p for p in inv if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w]
        if not inv: break
        for y,x in inv:
            if outg[y][x]==bgc: outg[y][x]=draw
        k+=1
    return outg

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

def f(I):

    rs=[p[0] for p in ob]; cs_=[p[1] for p in ob]
    br=min(rs); bc=min(cs_)
    sh=max(rs)-br+1; sw=max(cs_)-bc+1
    mr=sum(p[0] for p in marks)/len(marks); mc=sum(p[1] for p in marks)/len(marks)
    sr=1 if mr>=sum(rs)/len(rs) else -1; sc=1 if mc>=sum(cs_)/len(cs_) else -1

import numpy as np, json
def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I); h,w=I.shape; bg=int(np.unique(I)[0])
    cnt={c:int((I==c).sum()) for c in range(10) if c!=bg}
    objcol=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    ob=[(a,b) for a in range(h) for b in range(w) if int(I[a,b])==objcol]
    marks=[(a,b) for a in range(h) for b in range(w) if int(I[a,b]) not in (bg,objcol)]
    rs=[p[0] for p in ob]; cs_=[p[1] for p in ob]
    br=min(rs); bc=min(cs_)
    sh=max(rs)-br+1; sw=max(cs_)-bc+1
    mr=sum(p[0] for p in marks)/len(marks); mc=sum(p[1] for p in marks)/len(marks)
    sr=1 if mr>=sum(rs)/len(rs) else -1; sc=1 if mc>=sum(cs_)/len(cs_) else -1
    rel=sorted((a-br,b-bc) for a,b in ob)
    out=I.copy()
    k=1
    while True:
        t=(br+sr*k*sh, bc+sc*k*sw)
        n=sum(1 for a,b in rel if 0<=t[0]+a<h and 0<=t[1]+b<w)
        if n==0: break
        for a,b in rel:
            r,c=t[0]+a,t[1]+b
            if 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and int(out[r,c])==bg: out[r,c]=int(I[marks[0][0],marks[0][1]])
        k+=1
    return out.tolist()
for i in [6,7]:
    P=solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); O=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    print(i,'match:',P==O)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))
